label: Scene Template: Speaker Lower-Third
description: WHOLE-SCENE template for a talking-head beat where the film's speaker is on camera FULL-FRAME and a lower-third card names them (or states a key line). Instantiation is deterministic (NO codegen, NO critique): the scene is TRANSPARENT so the speaker-track camera fills the frame, and this shell paints only a legible frosted name/title card in a bottom corner. Use for the speaker intro ('here's who's talking'), a guest/quote attribution, or a persistent identifier while they talk. Do NOT use for screencasts (use st-speaker-screencast) or for content beside the speaker (use st-speaker-split).

name.label: Primary line -- the speaker's name (or a short key statement).

kicker.label: Optional small eyebrow above the name (e.g. 'FOUNDER' or 'LIVE').

position.label: Card position: bottom-left (default) | bottom-right | bottom-center. Keep it OFF the side the speaker's face occupies.

theme.label: dark (default -- frosted dark card, white type; best over most footage) | light (bright card, dark type; for bright/blown-out rooms).
